lines.text: Jehoahaz son of Jehu reigns seventeen years in Samaria, does evil, and the LORD delivers Israel to Hazael of Aram.
Jehoahaz seeks the LORD's favor, and the LORD gives Israel a deliverer.
Jehoahaz dies, and his son Jehoash reigns twenty-nine years and walks in Jeroboam's sins.
Elisha has Jehoash shoot from the east window, and the king strikes the ground seven times.
Israelites burying a man see raiders and throw him into Elisha's tomb, where he revives touching Elisha's bones.
